preprocessing: official weight transform: RGB, resize shorter side 236 bilinear antialias, center crop 224, float [0,1], ImageNet normalization
pooling: official adaptive average pool plus classifier LayerNorm/Flatten output before the 1000-class linear layer
feature_normalization_in_cache: none; per-image L2 is applied only by shared 1NN evaluator
notes: Architecture-matched supervised control for the ConvNeXt-Tiny candidates. The official 1000-class ImageNet head is loaded and then removed; it is never trained or used for Bai labels. No parameter updates, handcrafted features, class-name prompts, or test-set model selection.
